def evaluate_state(state_view, player_id):
    board = state_view.board
    captured = state_view.captured
    other = 1 - player_id
    own = board[player_id * 6:player_id * 6 + 6]
    opp = board[other * 6:other * 6 + 6]
    store_lead = captured[player_id] - captured[other]
    seed_lead = sum(own) - sum(opp)
    mobility_lead = int(own[0] > 0) + int(own[1] > 0) + int(own[2] > 0) + int(own[3] > 0) + int(own[4] > 0) + int(own[5] > 0) - int(opp[0] > 0) - int(opp[1] > 0) - int(opp[2] > 0) - int(opp[3] > 0) - int(opp[4] > 0) - int(opp[5] > 0)
    score = 0.8 * store_lead + 0.3 * seed_lead / (1 + sum(own) + sum(opp)) + 0.12 * mobility_lead
    return max(-10.0, min(10.0, float(score)))

def evaluate_state(state_view, player_id):
    board = state_view.board
    other = 1 - player_id
    own = board[player_id * 6:player_id * 6 + 6]
    opp = board[other * 6:other * 6 + 6]
    store_lead = state_view.captured[player_id] - state_view.captured[other]
    seed_lead = sum(own) - sum(opp)
    active_lead = int(own[0] > 0) + int(own[1] > 0) + int(own[2] > 0) + int(own[3] > 0) + int(own[4] > 0) + int(own[5] > 0) - int(opp[0] > 0) - int(opp[1] > 0) - int(opp[2] > 0) - int(opp[3] > 0) - int(opp[4] > 0) - int(opp[5] > 0)
    combined = 2.4 * store_lead + 0.3 * seed_lead + 0.55 * active_lead
    return max(-10.0, min(10.0, float(combined / 4.0)))
